comments: column actor_update_subscription.discovery_entity: What a Discovery-page request finds: actor, event or person.
column actor_update_subscription.discovery_options: Event requests: date_from, date_to, event_types. People requests: institution, role.
column actor_update_subscription.focus_terms: Sub-topic terms that narrow the search within the sector or topic. At most 8.
column actor_update_subscription.max_new_actors_per_run: Ceiling on new actors one run may stage; bounds review load and cost.
column actor_update_subscription.max_usd_per_run: Actor update requests only: the spend ceiling of one run, in USD.
column actor_update_subscription.requested_by: Who asked for this subscription. NULL until authentication exists; shown as "Not Recorded". Never defaulted, never inferred.

column actor_update_subscription.update_options: Actor update requests only: what to re-read (scope, depth, categories, boxes, focus, actor category, fact sector, actors per run). Empty for other requests.
column collection_run.initiated_by: Who asked for this run. NULL until authentication exists; displayed as "Not Recorded". Never defaulted, never inferred.
column hub_assignment_evidence.topic_matched: Whether the actor topic matched the hub topic. Still recorded, but since 2026-10-08 it is secondary: see dimension for what actually decided.
column query_log.retrieved_ids: Map entity UUIDs only. Uploaded document passages are counted in n_doc_passages, not stored here.
column search_doc.doc_tsv_simple: Literal simple-dictionary keyword index for acronyms and non-English terms.
constraint actor_update_subscription.ck_actor_update_subscription_scope: A subscription with no scope would sweep everything, which is the behaviour opt-in subscriptions replace.

constraint actor_verification_event.ck_actor_verification_event_origin: ghus_review = a person; existing_canonical_migration = pre-V2 carry-over; agent_auto_accept = the discovery agent accepted it on score and quality gates (verify only, reasons required).
table actor_read: Architecture V2 application read surface; stable across migration 500.
table proposal: RAG-owned inbox for agent-proposed changes. Human approval is required before source data changes.
table query_log: RAG-owned telemetry. Stores user questions/answers; default retention target is 12 months.
table search_doc: RAG-owned rebuildable search cache. Do not treat it as colleague-owned source data.
policies: actor_verification_event.actor_verification_event_ghus_insert INSERT service_role  ((decision_origin = 'ghus_review'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim(decided_by), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (migration_batch_id IS NULL))
